title: A zero-dimensional scheme of finite type over a field is finite and discrete
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $\dim X\le0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then $X$ is locally Noetherian and locally Artinian (for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ the ring $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ is an Artinian ring), the underlying topological space $|X|$ is discrete, and $|X|$ is a finite set. In particular every point of $X$ is closed (and open) [def-weil-closed-points].
